description: Agency hierarchy diagnostics for Dataset A Part 2. Investigates AGENCY_ID and PRIMARY_AGENCY_ID as hierarchical grouping variables before LMM fitting. Effective modeling population: 103,377 train / 30,981 test (same as OLS_ADDITIVE_FINAL and RF_1_SAFE_TUNED). No models fit in this script.

filters.na_exclusion: log_prev_wp and log_prev_poly NA rows excluded

part_c_agency_parent_mapping_stability.nested_lmm_threat_assessment: LOW: <5% of agencies have multiple parents. Hierarchy is largely stable.

agency_id_overlap.lmm_note: EBLUP available for seen agencies. New test agencies get random effect = 0.

part_e_hierarchy_shape.assessment: MOSTLY SINGLETONS: most parents have only one child agency — nested structure adds little over agency-only LMM

agency_level.interpretation: Approx ICC = 0.217. Between-agency variance = 1.0635 accounts for 22.1% of total variance. Substantial agency-level clustering — agency random effects strongly motivated.

agency_id.reasoning: Approx ICC = 0.217 indicates substantial agency-level clustering. 92.4% of test agencies seen in train — EBLUPs reliable for most test rows.

primary_agency_id.reasoning: 12.0% of rows have sentinel parent IDs. Exclude 1 sentinel IDs before using PRIMARY_AGENCY_ID.

nested_lmm.reasoning: Proceed with agency-only LMM first. Evaluate whether adding parent level improves fit meaningfully.

key_findings: AGENCY_ID: 1334 distinct agencies in effective population. Approx ICC = 0.217.
PRIMARY_AGENCY_ID: 578 distinct raw parent IDs. 1 flagged as suspicious/sentinel.
Self-parenting: 59.2% of rows have PRIMARY_AGENCY_ID == AGENCY_ID.
Agency-parent stability: 100.0% of agencies have exactly one parent ID.
Train/test overlap: 92.4% of test agencies seen in train.
Sentinel-adjusted hierarchy: 577 parents, median 1 agencies/parent, 66.0% singletons.
